# Vendored XML tooling

The unchanged SROS 2 schemas and permission transform come from ros2/sros2 commit `80a08ffa1bccd2de602c2acd120b209ad5f8ce83` (Jazzy branch, retrieved October 20, 2026). Copyright and license context: SROS 2 / Open Source Robotics Foundation and its contributors, Apache License 2.0; the upstream license is reproduced in `sros2/LICENSE`. Exact paths, URLs and SHA-256 hashes are recorded in `sources.json`. These files support the bounded offline example; their inclusion does not certify interoperability or current middleware behavior.

`xml.xsd` is the W3C XML namespace schema from https://www.w3.org/2001/03/xml.xsd. The schema is unchanged; its source URL and hash are retained. License: https://www.w3.org/Consortium/Legal/2002/copyright-software-20021231 .
